problem.original_text: Mixture with leakage (DE + concentration): A tank initially contains 100 L of pure water. Brine with 0.5 kg/L of salt flows in at 3 L/min, and the well-mixed solution flows out at 2 L/min (so the volume changes). Find the amount of salt in the tank after 20 minutes.
